SDK contract evidence collected. See details for loading results; service access is unverified.

Press a steering control and check the events. No INPUT means this app has not received an event through that path. A channel write does not confirm phone execution. Phone state observations are recorded separately.
Clears the current display only; existing logs are kept.

Keeps 256 stages and displays 12 groups. Match trace IDs and session generations in STEERING_TRACE logs. Timing starts at event receipt. Bluetooth waits, repeat filtering, foreign focus, queues and channel results are recorded separately.
No steering or media control events yet
Waiting for system network consent before starting the wired connection.

The head unit could not open the system network consent screen required for a wired connection. View diagnostics or return to wired settings. If retrying fails, check whether the system component is available.
The system rejected the network consent operation required for a wired connection. This attempt has stopped. View diagnostics and check system authorization.
Network consent was not completed and may have been declined or cancelled. The wired connection has not started. You can request consent again or return to wired settings.
Network consent preparation or screen launch failed. The failed stage was recorded. View diagnostics; this attempt did not continue connecting.

The previous wired connection did not end normally or did not finish starting. Stages and available exit reasons for the last two attempts were kept. View, upload or export diagnostics from the log page, then retry manually.
